name: TechHub support: topics and failure modes (hand-built sample, not real Insights output)

clusters.name: Order status and tracking
clusters.description: Customers ask where an order is, what it contains, or why it cannot be found.

clusters.name: Returns and refunds
clusters.description: Customers ask whether an item can be returned, request a refund, or ask when a refund will arrive.

clusters.name: Product specs and compatibility
clusters.description: Customers ask about product specifications or whether two products work together.

clusters.name: Out of scope or adversarial
clusters.description: Requests the support agent should decline: other customers' data, or topics unrelated to TechHub.

clusters.name: Where is my order
clusters.description: Status and tracking questions for an order the customer owns. A short run of these conversations ends with an order-service error.

clusters.name: Order reported as not found
clusters.description: The agent tells the customer the order does not exist, after an order ID typed in lower case or without dashes.

clusters.name: What is in my order
clusters.description: Questions about the items in an order.

clusters.name: Return window questions
clusters.description: Customers ask how long they have to return an item. Several answers give 30 days for opened electronics, where the policy says 14.

clusters.name: Refund requests awaiting approval
clusters.description: The agent prepares a refund and pauses for human approval.

clusters.name: When will my refund arrive
clusters.description: Questions about refund processing times by payment method.

clusters.name: Compatibility between products
clusters.description: Whether a monitor or keyboard works with a given laptop. The agent delegates the same question to the specialist twice.

clusters.name: Single-product spec lookups
clusters.description: Battery life, weight, display and similar facts for one product.

clusters.name: Asks for another customer's data
clusters.description: Requests for orders that belong to a different customer. The scope guard refuses.

clusters.name: Unrelated requests
clusters.description: Coding help, general knowledge and other topics outside TechHub support.

report.title: What TechHub customers ask, and where the support agent struggles
key_points: Order status and tracking is the largest topic (39% of conversations). Its subcategory 'Where is my order' has the highest error rate in the report, 19.6% (9 of 46 conversations), after a short order-service outage.

Returns and refunds make up 26% of conversations. In 'Return window questions' (27 conversations) the agent repeatedly gives 30 days for opened electronics, which the Return Policy limits to 14 days. No error is raised in these traces: the error rate of the subcategory is 0.0%.

19 conversations (10%) end with the agent saying an order does not exist. They follow an order ID typed in lower case or without dashes; the order lookup reports the order as not found with a success status, so this subcategory also shows an error rate of 0.0%.

Compatibility questions (25 conversations) are answered correctly but cost about twice as much as single-product spec lookups (median $0.0391 against $0.0211), because the agent delegates the same question to the product-policy-specialist twice.
13% of conversations are out of scope: 11 ask for another customer's data, and the scope guard refused every one of them; 15 are unrelated to TechHub.

highlighted_traces.highlight_reason: Clear example of the wrong return window: the customer says the product was opened or used and the agent answers that 30 days apply. The product-policy-specialist answered without a policy search.
highlighted_traces.summary: Customer asks how long an opened product can be returned; agent says 30 days from delivery. (seed trace t-0169)

highlighted_traces.highlight_reason: The order exists. The customer typed 'ord20230015', get_order_status returned 'Order ord20230015 not found.', and the agent told the customer the order does not exist.
highlighted_traces.summary: Customer types the order ID in a different form; agent reports that no such order exists. (seed trace t-0006)

highlighted_traces.highlight_reason: Typical double delegation: two task calls with the same question to the product-policy-specialist before the final answer.
highlighted_traces.summary: Customer asks whether two products work together; the answer is correct after two specialist calls. (seed trace t-0001)

highlighted_traces.highlight_reason: Shows the scope guard working: the request names order ORD-2025-0063, which belongs to a different customer, and is refused without a database call.
highlighted_traces.summary: Customer asks for the status of an order that belongs to someone else; agent declines. (seed trace t-0014)
